title: Ontario Opens Applications for Development Charge Reduction Program
summary:
Ontario municipalities can now apply for funding through the new Development Charge Reduction Program (DCRP), part of the up to $8.8 billion Canada-Ontario Partnership to Build announced earlier this year. Applications opened on June 1, 2026 for the program, which would provide federal and provincial funding for housing-enabling infrastructure in municipalities that reduce residential development charges by 30% to 50% or more and maintain those reductions for at least three years. The application deadline is June 19.

“The Development Charge Reduction Program will make a life-changing difference for families in municipalities across Ontario by lowering the cost of new homes by tens of thousands of dollars,” said Ontario Minister of Municipal Affairs and Housing Rob Flack.
